purpose: select recurrent SiLU or sigmoid only on the independently selected mixer and positional parent, without treating one-seed GDN evidence or bundled KDA results as a general gate effect

seed42_GDN_language.limitation: one seed; later GDN/sigmoid stability runs do not contain paired GDN/SiLU controls

synthetic_MQAR.interpretation: the gate effect reverses between one language result and GDN synthetic memory, while KDA may interact with sigmoid; task and mixer conditionality must be measured

bundled_frontier.reason: the replicated frontier contains sigmoid in both arms and no SiLU treatment controls

parent_selection.requirement: one recurrent mixer and one global positional treatment selected without a general NoPE claim

KDA_code_successor_if_selected: add output_gate_activation to KimiDeltaAttentionSpec with default sigmoid
dispatch only sigmoid or silu after output_norm
prove old field-absent and explicit-sigmoid configs normalize identically
prove old sigmoid checkpoint state_dict keys and tensors load strictly without conversion
prove old and successor sigmoid forward, backward, cached decode, export, parameters, state bytes, and FLOPs are exact
qualify SiLU Torch and FLA training/cached paths
ordered_prerequisites.active_sequence_rule: do not modify architecture.py or model.py until every active finalist cell is complete because future services import those files

conditional_experiment.parent: exact selected mixer, global position treatment, layer count/placement, cache representation, FFN, residual, tokenizer, data, optimizer, and evaluation
conditional_experiment.reuse_sigmoid_rule: reuse six results only if their full parent identity equals the selected parent and every result passes the applicable acceptance verifier

analysis.effect: sigmoid minus SiLU within seed and data-order cell
analysis.quality: aggregate and every-source language non-inferiority plus all selected-parent capability floors
analysis.stability: nonfinite events, gradient tails, loss spikes, seed variance, and convergence tails are hard reports
analysis.systems: measure realized training time/energy and cached runtime; activation FLOPs are not assumed equal in hardware
analysis.missing_or_failed_cell: retain and fail; no imputation, replacement, retry, or skip

decision_rule.sigmoid_selection: sigmoid passes all language/source/capability/stability gates and is non-dominated on realized systems evidence
decision_rule.SiLU_selection: retain SiLU if sigmoid fails any hard gate or SiLU is the cheaper non-dominated passing point

registration_boundary.next_action: complete the active finalist and NoPE factorial; select the parent, then implement KDA gate configurability only if needed and freeze exact run identities before training
